status.main_product: FinShare supply chain and trade finance platform
status.scope_reason: The company builds and sells its flagship FinShare platform which directly provides software and core digital ecosystems for supply chain finance and trade finance products such as letters of credit and bank guarantees.
status.evidence: According to Premium Technology Inc.'s official website and press releases, the company celebrated its 25th anniversary in September 2026 and continues to provide its FinShare supply chain and trade finance platform.

Premium Technology Inc..listed_hq: New York City, New York, USA

claims.claim: The company reports that its FinShare platform supports customizable standard output templates including SWIFT messages as well as core banking and third-party integration capabilities.
claims.source: Premium Technology Inc. Official Trade Finance Product Page (https://www.premiumit.com/TF)

claims.claim: SWIFT designated the FinShare platform as a certified software application for Supply Chain Finance, which validates support for the SWIFT Trade Services Utility (TSU) and Bank Payment Obligation (BPO).
claims.source: Premium Technology Inc. Press Release via PR Newswire (https://www.newswire.ca/news-releases/premium-technology-earns-swift-certification-for-supply-chain-finance-512884571.html)

claims.claim: The company reports that its FinShare platform supports over 50,000 corporate clients across more than 100 countries and processes over 50 million transactions monthly.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its FinShare platform supports over 50,000 corporate clients across more than 100 countries and processes over 30 million transactions monthly.
claims.source: Premium Technology Inc. FinShare Platform Page (https://www.premiumit.com/Platform)

claims.claim: Global Trade Review documented that Premium Technology expanded Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation's (SMBC) supply chain finance solutions across nine global regions, including the US, UK, and UAE, and developed an automated open account financing workflow for Thailand's Krungthai Bank.
claims.source: Global Trade Review Leaders in Trade 2025 Awards Report (https://www.gtreview.com/magazine/the-supply-chain-issue-2025/gtr-leaders-trade-2025-nominees-winners/)

claims.claim: Premium Technology and independent industry updates confirmed a collaboration with Hatton National Bank (HNB) in Sri Lanka to power its "TxB ValueX" digital trade and supply chain platform launched in May 2026.
claims.source: Premium Technology Inc. Corporate News and LinkedIn Announcements (https://premiumit.com/News and https://www.linkedin.com/posts/teranpasindudharmasiri_hnb-hattonnationalbank-hnbtxb-activity-7459936423803006976-_aEk)

claims.claim: The company reports that its flagship FinShare platform supports over 50,000 corporates across more than 100 countries globally.
claims.source: Premium Technology Inc. LinkedIn Company Profile and Sibos Exhibitor Profile

claims.claim: Premium Technology Inc. reports that it was founded in 2001 and remains a privately held software development company providing supply-chain finance and trade finance solutions.
claims.source: Premium Technology Inc. Official Website (Who We Are and About Pages)

claims.claim: The company reports that its FinShare platform serves over 50,000 clients across more than 100 countries and processes over 30 million monthly transactions.
claims.source: Premium Technology Inc. Official Website (FinShare Platform Overview Page)

claims.claim: Publicly announced deployments verify that the company's platform has been rolled out across multiple Tier-1 and regional financial institutions, including expanding SMBC's supply chain finance solutions across nine global regions in 2024, building an automated end-to-end workflow system for Thailand's Krungthai Bank, and powering HNB's TxB ValueX platform launched in May 2026.
claims.source: Global Trade Review (GTR) Leaders in Trade Awards Coverage and Premium Technology Inc. Official Newsroom
